newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Vision in Canadian franchise pact.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Vision in Canadian franchise pact.

text.p: Sterling Vision Inc said Thursday it has completed the sale of four optical stores to Eye-Site Inc of Toronto.
Eye-Site has agreed to run the stores as Sterling franchises and also convert five stores it already owns into Sterling franchises.
In addition, Eye-Site has contracted to open 40 more Sterling franchises in Ontario over a period of time, Sterling said.
Sterling, a chain of 350 company-owned and franchised optical retail stores, said additionally that it "may complete additional acquisitions before the end of this year."
Besides its stores, Sterling also operates laser vision correction centers through its subsidiary, Insight Laser Centers.
